title: Restored link sequence journal remains resettable through public setter
description: Post-fix correctness review: after a signed sequence journal is restored, `_sequence_started` remains false, so public `set_sequence()` can reset the transmit tuple below the durable high-water and reuse signed counters. A restored journal must irrevocably mark counter state initialized, or the setter must be removed or restricted. Lower, equal, and higher post-restore resets must fail without mutation, and the next send must use the restored tuple. Add restart-plus-setter persistence tests.
